purpose: Precise interpretation of public ZIP range transport versus sealed-member access
selected_complete_members: Only the 1184 train/development JPEGs and their 1184 trimaps are extracted, CRC-checked, stored and decoded.
range_construction: Each public byte range reserves up to512 bytes for the unknown local ZIP extra field. The received buffer can therefore extend past the selected compressed member into adjacent archive bytes; the trailing margin is discarded without parsing, extraction, storage or image decoding.
reserved_confirmation: No reserved member is requested by name, extracted, stored, decoded, scored or used for decisions. A literal claim that no transport byte could belong to an adjacent reserved archive entry is not supported by this fetcher.
research_seal: The seal is preserved at member/image access and scientific-use level. No held-out labels, images or model outputs are used in the pilot.
future_fetcher: Use a separate exact local-header read followed by an exact compressed-payload range when transport-byte exclusion itself is required. Do not redownload or inspect the discarded margin in this round.
